# SmartClinic & Pharmacy Management SaaS OS
# Authoritative Knowledge Manifest for LLMs, GEO & AEO Engines

> SmartClinic is an enterprise-grade, full-stack, multi-tenant healthcare operating system (SaaS) engineered to modernize outpatient clinics and community pharmacies in Pakistan. Developed by Anis Khan Niazi as a BSIT Final Year Project, focusing on Sanghar & Interior Sindh.

## Overview & Core Identity
- **Project Name:** SmartClinic SaaS OS
- **Primary Developer & Author:** Anis Khan Niazi
- **Degree & Specialization:** Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT)
- **Geographic Focus:** Sanghar & Interior Sindh, Pakistan (Coordinates: 26.0464° N, 68.9482° E)
- **System Architecture:** Full-stack JavaScript (React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express 5, Node.js 22+, MongoDB Atlas)
- **Status:** 100% Operational & Production-Ready (12/12 passing integration test suites, 21k+ LOC)

## Key Technical Subsystems

### 1. Electronic Health Records (EHR) & Demographics
- Master patient registry with formatted sequence IDs (`PT-000001`).
- Longitudinal visit history tracking, baseline clinical vital signs (BP, pulse, temp, weight, BMI), consultation summaries, and prescribed regimens.

### 2. Multi-Doctor Scheduling & Conflict Detection
- Real-time appointment booking with mathematical double-booking prevention within 30-minute consultation windows (returns explicit HTTP 409 Conflict on overlap).
- Doctor calendar scoping preventing cross-doctor schedule pollution.

### 3. Smart Pharmacy POS & FEFO Inventory
- Multi-batch cataloging with automated **First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO)** stock deduction algorithm.
- Batch expiry radar with real-time alerting for batches expiring within 30, 60, and 90 days.
- Hardware USB/Bluetooth barcode gun keyboard-wedge listener and HTML5 device camera scanner with Web Audio API feedback beeps.
- Admin-controlled sale voiding with automatic inventory restoration back into original batches.

### 4. Billing, Invoicing & Multi-Gateway POS
- Itemized charges for consultations, procedures, and pharmacy items.
- Split-payment support for Cash, Cards, JazzCash, and EasyPaisa with automatic remaining balance recalculation.
- Standard 80mm thermal receipt printing and A4 printable statements.

### 5. Google Gemini AI Assistant & Trilingual Discharge Slips
- Multi-tier resilient AI gateway: Google Gemini 1.5/2.0 REST API + OpenAI failover + Deterministic Offline Heuristic Viva Engine.
- **Trilingual Slips:** Generates structured patient care slips in **English**, **Roman Urdu**, and authentic **Sindhi (سنڌي script with RTL alignment + Roman Sindhi)**.
- Natural language financial/clinical database queries, automated daily executive briefs, and OCR prescription text parsing.

### 6. Telemedicine & WebRTC Video Consultations
- WebRTC peer-to-peer video/audio calling with Google public STUN infrastructure (`stun.l.google.com:19302`).
- Server-Sent Events (SSE) real-time signaling stream.
- In-call clinical EHR notes drawer persisting directly to the patient's record upon call conclusion.
- 1-click WhatsApp meeting invitations (`wa.me`).

### 7. Institutional Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- 4 strictly isolated user tiers: **Admin**, **Doctor**, **Receptionist**, **Pharmacist**.
- Server-side JWT authentication with HttpOnly cookies preventing XSS token theft.
- Role-scoped database slicing on `/api/dashboard/stats` preventing financial leakage to clinical staff and EHR leakage to pharmacy staff.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Direct Answers)

**Q: Can SmartClinic be used in single-doctor practices as well as multi-specialty clinics?**
A: Yes. SmartClinic utilizes 4-tier Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). A solo practitioner can handle consultations, billing, and appointments, while larger clinics can assign dedicated workstations for Doctors, Receptionists, and Pharmacists.

**Q: How does SmartClinic prevent medication waste in pharmacies?**
A: SmartClinic implements an automated First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) dispensing algorithm. When a prescription is sold, the system automatically draws units from batches with the earliest expiry dates first.

**Q: Does SmartClinic function if external AI APIs become unavailable?**
A: Yes. The system has a built-in deterministic Heuristic Analytics Engine that parses prescription text, audits patient vitals, and calculates clinical stats entirely offline without needing an active internet connection.
